_comment: Whole-network tile. The DLC behind it is dronet_full_hta (BN-rewritten + conv head + trailing Reshape dropped) so the graph composes on HTA; op-level correspondence to the PyTorch IR is therefore structural, not name-by-name. Splitting dronet into its 7 residual blocks measured 3.49 ms summed vs 0.92 ms whole on dsp — per-dispatch cost dominates at this size.
lowering_note: dronet_full_hta.onnx: BatchNorm folded offline into the conv weights (optimization_flow.md #6 — the plain export does not fold and HTA then rejects the graph), FC head re-expressed as 1x1 conv (#8), trailing Reshape dropped (#11).
